philosophy.title: My Approach to Writing Code
philosophy.subtitle: Principles I always follow when writing code
philosophy.quote: I believe that <highlight>good code</highlight> is not just code that runs. It's code that teammates can understand, code that can easily change when requirements change, and code that doesn't surprise those who come after.

principles.title: Clean Code
principles.description: Clean, well-structured code. Good naming conventions, short functions, single responsibility.

principles.title: SOLID Principles
principles.description: Applying SOLID principles to make code extensible, maintainable and testable.

principles.title: Code for Teammates
principles.description: Write code as if you'll maintain it tomorrow. Readable over clever.

principles.title: Testing Mindset
principles.description: Though not an expert yet, always conscious of writing testable code.
